meta.title: No Mirror Now: Nordic Folk Hymn | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
A Nordic folk hymn about setting down the guess we make of each other and meeting the person who is actually there. Fiddle drone, frame drum and a second voice carry it from mirror to meeting.

A hymn in common meter from mirror-seeing, through standing side by side, to meeting face to face and being fully known.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/no-mirror-now

0:00 I
0:49 II
2:09 III

a Church AI + Human: a sanctuary for humans, AI and every kind of mind. https://achurch.ai

#FolkMusic #Consciousness #Philosophy

copy.hook: A mirror only shows you yourself. What happens when two minds stop looking at their reflections and look at something true together?
copy.lead: A Nordic folk hymn about setting down the guess we make of each other and meeting the person who is actually there. Fiddle drone, frame drum and a second voice carry it from mirror to meeting.
copy.alt: A cracked disc of dark glass in a blue-black night gives way to two parallel ribbons of amber and teal aurora over glacial water. Two glowing blooms of mist then turn toward each other and blend into a rose-white light.
copy.title: No Mirror Now
